description: This file contains a full implementation of AES encryption algorithms, including key setup, encryption, decryption, and various modes such as ECB, CBC, CFB, CTR, and OFB. It also includes self-test routines and references to hardware acceleration support. The code is part of the mbed TLS library and is designed to be FIPS-197 compliant.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_init
methods.description: Initializes the AES context structure to zero.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_free
methods.description: Zeroizes and frees the AES context structure.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_setkey_enc
methods.description: Sets the encryption key schedule for AES.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_setkey_dec
methods.description: Sets the decryption key schedule for AES.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a single 16-byte block using the AES context.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a single 16-byte block using the AES context.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_crypt_ecb
methods.description: Performs AES encryption or decryption in ECB mode.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_crypt_cbc
methods.description: Performs AES encryption or decryption in CBC mode.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_crypt_cfb128
methods.description: Performs AES encryption or decryption in CFB128 mode.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_crypt_cfb8
methods.description: Performs AES encryption or decryption in CFB8 mode.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_crypt_ctr
methods.description: Performs AES encryption or decryption in CTR mode.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_crypt_ofb
methods.description: Performs AES encryption or decryption in OFB mode.

methods.name: mbedtls_aes_self_test
methods.description: Runs self-tests to verify AES implementation correctness.
